results.title: Encoder-Decoder Architectures: U-Net & SegNet
results.content: Encoder-Decoder Architectures: U-Net & SegNet. # Encoder-Decoder Architectures: U-Net and SegNet. Fully Convolutional Networks (FCNs) enabled end-to-end semantic segmentation, mapping input images directly to pixel-wise predictions. 1. The **Encoder** path gradually reduces the spatial resolution of the input image while simultaneously increasing the number of feature channels. ### U-Net: Symmetric Architecture with Skip Connections. 1. **Symmetric Encoder-Decoder:** The decoder path largely mirrors the encoder path in terms of the number of layers and feature map sizes at corresponding stages. Before each up-convolution step in the decoder, the feature map is concatenated with the corresponding feature map from the encoder path (one that has the same spatial resolution). SegNet shares the encoder-decoder structure with U-Net but introduces a different mechanism for upsampling in the decoder path, primarily motivated by computational and memory efficiency.

For image processing, it is typical to use CNN for feature extraction. The CNN in the encoder is without fully connected layers. Finally, it upsamples the image to add back the fine details of the image. It repeats the process until the image is upsampled back to its original input dimension. Fully Convolutional Neural Networks include the following:. These fully convolutional neural networks introduced replacements for fully connected layers with convolutional layers. In it, the earlier convolutional layers act as the encoder and the later convolutional layers act as the decoder. The decoders of the Fully convolutional Network can be FCN-32, FCN-16, or FCN-8. SegNet is one of the Fully Convolutional Networks where the encoder layer is symmetric to the decoder layers. results.title: Alternate encoder and dual decoder CNN-Transformer networks for ...
results.content: Alternate encoder and dual decoder CNN-Transformer networks for medical image segmentation. In recent years, methods based on convolutional neural networks and Transformer have achieved great success in the medical image segmentation field. Combining the powerful perception of local information by CNNs and the efficient capture of global context by Transformer is crucial for medical image segmentation. Therefore, based on an encoder-decoder architecture, we propose a novel alternate encoder dual decoder CNN-Transformer network, AD2Former, with two attractive designs: 1) We propose alternating learning encoder can achieve real-time interaction between local and global information, allowing both to mutually guide learning. To efficiently fuse different feature information from two sub-decoders during decoding, we introduce a channel attention module to reduce redundant feature information. Experiments on multi-organ segmentation and skin lesion segmentation datasets also demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of AD2Former. ### Dual-attention transformer-based hybrid network for multi-modal medical image segmentation.
